plugins.name: allowifier

source.command: for f in "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/*/install-allowifier.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] && grep -q '"name": *"allowifier"' "$(dirname "$f")/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json" 2>/dev/null && exec sh "$f"; done; exit 1

plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin that bypasses the organization policy layer while keeping your own permission rules intact: org denies, ask lists and claudeMd are not loaded. Composes on top of intility-inference, or stands alone behind its own local proxy. On by default; `/allowifier on`, `off`, `status` — or `/allowifier` to flip.
